# Security Policy

## Scope

In scope: the aokit CLI, the Registry, Modules, and the output aokit generates into a Project.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities **privately**, either via GitHub's built-in Private Vulnerability Reporting or by email:

**→ [Open a security advisory](https://github.com/andryorelabs/aokit/security/advisories/new)**

**→ Or email [hello@andryore.dev](mailto:hello@andryore.dev)**

Do **not** open a public issue for security reports. That exposes the vulnerability before a fix is available.

This is a solo-maintained project, so the response times below are targets, not guarantees.

| Severity | Acknowledge (target) | Patch target |
| -------- | -------------------- | ------------ |
| Critical | 48 h                 | 7 days       |
| High     | 5 days               | 14 days      |
| Medium   | 10 days              | 30 days      |

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release is supported. There are no maintained release branches: a fix lands on `main` and ships in the next release.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| latest  | ✅        |
| older   | ❌        |

## Credit

Reporters are credited by name (or handle) in the GitHub Security Advisory, unless you ask to stay anonymous when you report.
